items.title: Understanding the Nature of a Prayer
items.explanation: A prayer is a request or wish made to God or a higher power. In this chapter, the speaker asks for specific things: that her friend brings idli, they win a race, and that she gets well soon.

items.title: The Poet's Feelings About Friendship
items.explanation: The poet feels blessed with special friends. She believes these friendships make her feel brave and special. She wishes to do much more than just share hopes and plans, trying hard to make their wishes come true.

items.title: Characteristics of a True Friend
items.explanation: A true friend accepts you for all your qualities. They love you the way you are, without making judgments from afar. Good friends share things with each other and support one another.
